# Melyn Community Notices Mobile App

> A React Native & Expo application built for First Nations community members to access emergency notices, events, services, and community updates.

## Technical & Architectural Overview
- Full Project Specification & AI Context: [PROJECT_CONTEXT.md](PROJECT_CONTEXT.md)
- App Readme & Demo Video: [README.md](README.md)
- Package Manifest & Dependencies: [package.json](package.json)

## Core Codebase Structure
- Feed Screen: `src/app/index.tsx`
- Detail Screen: `src/app/notice/[id].tsx`
- Feed State Hook: `src/hooks/useNotices.ts`
- Detail State Hook: `src/hooks/useNoticeDetail.ts`
- Mock API Layer: `src/services/api/noticesApi.ts`
- Local Persistence Layer: `src/services/storage/noticeStorage.ts`
- Types & Interfaces: `src/types/notice.ts`
- UI Components: `src/components/notices/`
